name: ProductList
description: Responsive, data-driven YAMI product collection with rail and waterfall layouts, campaign appearances, and card or full-bleed mobile section surfaces.

figma.notes: Product List / 产品列表. PC rail set 3878:61068 and PC waterfall 3878:61095.

title.description: Visible list heading and accessible section label.

description.description: Optional supporting copy rendered to the right of the section title and below it on narrow screens.

introContent.description: Optional full-width editorial content rendered once between the heading controls and product collection.

products.description: ProductCard data with a stable id for each item.

leadingContent.description: Optional editorial content stacked above the mobile product rail and rendered before the first desktop rail product; ThemeProductList uses it to reserve two desktop card slots.

layout.description: Responsive collection layout. ProductCard presentation is selected internally.

mobileSurface.description: Mobile-only section surface. Card preserves the inset rounded panel and ignores divider configuration. Plain is full-bleed with 16px content padding and honors dividerPosition/dividerVariant.

presentation.description: Optional ProductCard presentation override for composed collection patterns.

tabs.description: Tertiary navigation tabs. Selection does not filter products internally.

viewAllHref.description: Destination for the optional view-all link.

hasMore.description: Shows the waterfall load-more action when true.

onAddToCart.description: Reports the ID of the product whose independent quick-add action was pressed.

loading.description: Hides products and renders layout-specific skeletons.

dividerPosition.description: Places the desktop section boundary above, below, or removes it. Mobile plain surfaces honor the same setting; mobile card surfaces ignore it.

dividerVariant.description: Gray preserves the existing 1px structural separator; black uses the theme-aware 2px emphasis separator.

banner.type: { src: string; mobileSrc?: string; alt: string; backgroundColor?: string; mobileBackgroundColor?: string }
banner.description: Semantic campaign banner with optional mobile art direction and precomputed responsive dominant colors used by the themed surface and bottom-edge gradient.

backgroundColor.description: Precomputed bottom-edge color for the atmospheric surface and image-to-surface gradient.

backgroundImage.description: Decorative desktop CSS background for atmospheric appearance.

backgroundImageMobile.description: Optional decorative mobile and tablet CSS background for atmospheric appearance. Falls back to backgroundImage when omitted.

tapTarget.note: Rail arrows, quick add, and load-more actions compose YAMI Button controls.

focus.note: Links, tabs, and desktop pagination buttons remain keyboard reachable.

radius.note: Cards and skeleton geometry consume semantic radius slots only.

motion.note: Rail scrolling and skeleton shimmer respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.ariaPattern: labelled section containing a product list and optional tabs, links, and buttons
accessibility.structure: Visible heading labels the section. Products use list/listitem. Themed banner requires alt text; atmospheric art is decorative CSS.
accessibility.interaction: Product navigation and quick-add remain independent. Loading exposes aria-busy and localized status copy while skeletons are aria-hidden.
